sources.name: Arizona Secretary of State — candidate filings
sources.note: Arizona Secretary of State Partisan Candidate Filing for 2026 Primary Election, February 23, 2026, to March 23, 2026 — official list of candidates who qualified for the July 21, 2026 Primary Ballot pending any court-ordered removal, ARS § 16-351 — acquired as a corpus at data/candidates/az-2026-sos-candidate-filings.json (183097 B, sha256 a13d2a82f83b52206d3697a840382403b1c3d5cb6c80481e383b42d360669016). THE REGISTRY'S POPULATION. Every candidate the Arizona Secretary of State lists as qualified for the July 21, 2026 primary ballot, for every office the Secretary is the filing officer for: federal congressional, statewide executive, and legislative. Complete for those offices.

sources.name: Pima County certified general-election ballot
sources.note: NOT the population. Read for one thing only: the held `ballot-az-pima:*` candidacy keys the campaign-money corpus is written against, carried onto the 55 registry candidates the Secretary's list and this ballot both name.
